subject: CloudWave onboarding — PO number request, spend cap confirmation, and SKU split correction
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudwave.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudWave Finance <ap@cloudwave.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood onboarding: PO number and spend cap

Hi Vivek / Monica,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Attached is our completed onboarding form and a W-9 — can you confirm the steps on your side so we can get a PO number issued? Two items to note from our procurement team:

- We need a single PO for the initial committed spend of $125,000, but CloudWave prefers the invoice be split across three internal SKUs: "dev-100", "svc-200", and "support-300" so the budget owners can track consumption.
- Our finance policy requires a per-line spend cap at SKU level (max $60,000 per SKU for the first term). Please confirm Redwood can set those caps on the PO or whether we need separate POs per SKU.

We'll attach a proposed PO template (CSV) if that helps — otherwise our AP team can accept your PO number and we'll map it to our internal codes.

Attachments: CW_Onboarding_Form_20260210.pdf (onboarding form), CloudWave_W9.pdf (W-9)

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Sr. Procurement Manager
CloudWave Systems
liam.oconnor@cloudwave.com

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudwave.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding: PO number and spend cap

Hi Liam — thanks for sending everything over. Quick read-through and a couple clarifying points before we request a formal PO number from Finance: 

1) SKU split is fine — Redwood can accept a single PO with multiple line items that map to your internal SKUs. We just need clear line-item descriptions and the dollar amounts per line.
2) Spend caps: our billing system can record an allocation per line item but the enforcement model differs. We can:
   - Put a tracked allocation per SKU (informational) and send alerts when forecasted usage approaches the cap, or
   - Create separate billing budget controls that block spend when a cap is reached (this requires a separate contract flag and Finance sign-off).

Which behavior do you want for the initial term? If you want hard enforcement, we'll need your AP/Finance to sign the spend-control addendum (I can loop Marissa from Finance). Otherwise we can set up alerts and a monthly review.

I'll attach the proposed PO CSV you mentioned so Ben can ingest it and prepare the PO request to our Finance team.

Attachments: Proposed_PO_1457_v2.csv

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding & Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

From: CloudWave Finance <ap@cloudwave.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding: PO number and spend cap

On Thu, Feb 12, 2026 at 08:22 AM CloudWave Finance <ap@cloudwave.com> wrote:

> Hi Monica / Ben / Vivek,
> 
> We need hard spend enforcement at SKU level for the first 90 days — that is non-negotiable from my controller. If Redwood cannot block at the SKU cap, we'll need separate POs per SKU.
> 
> I've attached a redlined PO CSV with the three SKUs and proposed dollar splits that match internal budget owners. Please confirm if Redwood can:
> 
>  - Issue a single PO number and enforce caps per line (block) OR
>  - If not, issue three PO numbers (one per SKU) and confirm which approach is faster so we can calendar invoices.
>
> Thanks,
> Priya Malhotra
> AP Manager, CloudWave Systems
> ap@cloudwave.com

Attachments: Proposed_PO_1457_v2.csv (redlined)

--
Note: we need Finance's OK for hard blocks. Ben — can you confirm the expected lead time to get either the single-block-enabled PO or three separate POs through Finance?

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudWave Ops <ops@cloudwave.com>, CloudWave Finance <ap@cloudwave.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Redwood onboarding: PO number request, spend cap confirmation, and SKU split correction

Folks — quick internal plan and ask to close this week: 

1) Ben: please open a PO request with Finance for a single PO number (PO-1457) with three line items mirroring the CSV. Ask Finance to enable hard enforcement per-line if available; if Finance requires a contract flag, escalate to Marissa for sign-off. Estimated lead: 48 business hours.

2) Monica: draft the spend-control addendum language (2–3 bullets) that clearly states how blocks behave (per-line hard block, notification cadence, and fallback process). I'll share this with Priya and Liam.

3) Marissa: can you confirm whether Finance is comfortable adding the contract flag for an initial 90-day hard block? If not, we will request three separate PO numbers and notify CloudWave.

We should avoid issuing three POs unless strictly necessary — single PO + per-line enforcement is preferable for CloudWave's internal mapping.

I'll coordinate the DocuSign once Ben has the PO format. Monica — please copy in any standard addendum template you think is appropriate.

Thanks — Vivek

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Operations (acting)
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced in thread: CW_Onboarding_Form_20260210.pdf, CloudWave_W9.pdf, Proposed_PO_1457_v2.csv
